scope: Custom — Chicago Bears @ Seattle Seahawks only
scope_description: NFL Week 8, 2026 Regular Season — tonight's game only: Chicago Bears @ Seattle Seahawks, Monday November 2, 2026, 8:15 PM ET

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 7
historical_cutoff.cutoff: Immediately after actual completion of the final scheduled Week 7 game; Stage 1 must verify completion and exclude all Week 8 games.

distribution_statistic_override.sample_definition: Use the 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games before the historical cutoff, separate from L10
distribution_statistic_override.qualification_use: Not a Stage 1 qualification requirement; do not use sportsbook pricing to calculate 16P

eligibility_method: Current Week 8 depth-chart and injury-report screening: starting QBs; primary/secondary backs; top three expected available WRs; top expected TE.
qualification_rule: Market HR >= 6/10 OR at least one applicable fixed ladder threshold >= 8/10. Market over hits use statistic > current line; fixed ladder hits use statistic >= threshold.
